NURSE GEORGIE CARROLL BRINGS THE LAUGHS (AND THE SCRUBS) TO CANADA!!!

WITH HER SMASH-HIT SHOW INFECTIOUS – PRESENTED BY A-LIST ENTERTAINMENT

Back by (medical) demand – award-winning comedian, bestselling author, and real-life nurse Georgie Carroll is scrubbing in for a massive international tour with her wildly popular solo show, Infectious.

Following her Britain’s Got Talent semi-finalist run and a string of sold-out shows for Sista Flo 2.0 (75,000+ tickets sold), Georgie is ready to triage audiences across the globe – one laugh at a time. Georgie says: “I sit down, look at the map and think – who needs a good tickle next? That’s how tours are born.”

With decades of experience on the frontlines, Georgie turns chaos into comedy with her trademark wit, warmth and brutally honest storytelling. Infectious isn’t just a title – it’s a diagnosis. Whether you’ve worked in health, been in a hospital, or just know someone with a body – this show is for you.

Saturday, January 17
Doors 6:00 pm | Show 7:00 pm *Start time subject to change. Please arrive on time.
Tickets HERE

ABOUT GEORGIE
Georgie Carroll is a comedian, registered nurse, and bestselling author of Off The Charts. Her stand-up storytelling celebrates the human side of healthcare – gritty, ridiculous and very, very funny. Her viral clip The Three Stages of Nursing has racked up over 7 million views, proving that medicine and comedy can be a perfect match.

SHAWN CHIDIAC is the man behind @myparents_are_divorced and all the voices that come with him. Lebanese, born in Canada. Raised in Dubai by a single mum. Followed by over 1.1 million people across social media who watch him turn into other people, the accents, the characters, the impressions that feel like someone from your own family. With his mass of online success it has allowed him to sell out venues such as Dubai Opera.

Live, he does it right in front of you. He writes every word himself. The characters come out, the accents land, and stories from his own mixed-up childhood turn into jokes that feel like they’re about yours. That’s the whole idea.

For years, Vancouver has topped global rankings as one of the world’s most livable cities, while British Columbia has marketed itself as a paradise of mountains, rainforests and ocean—a destination unlike any other.  In “Searching for the Best Place on Earth”, Vancouver journalist Justin McElroy embarks on an ambitious trip, visiting nearly every “world-class” city on the planet.

Monday, November 9
Doors 6:00 pm | Event 7:00 pm *Start time subject to change. Please arrive on time.
Tickets HERE

Copies of Justin’s book will be available for purchasing and signing at the event.

His personal mission was to see the world—as well as to rank as many things as he could, from cuisines to museums to national train systems. His professional mission was to see how Vancouver truly compares. Does BC’s celebrated identity hold up?

As a neurodivergent traveller, McElroy is also frank about sensory overload, but once on the road, he’s surprised by how comfortably he adapts to a new routine of being a tourist for a year.

With his signature wit and deep knowledge of his home province, McElroy offers a fresh perspective on what makes a city truly exceptional—and whether BC still deserves its reputation as the “best place on earth.”

The evening’s event will be moderated by the Host of CBC Radio One’s, ‘The Early Edition,’ Stephen Quinn.

“Justin McElroy… captures and defines what a world-class city is… A good read that I recommend you pick up.”
— Mike Harcourt, former mayor of Vancouver and premier of British Columbia

“What is a world class city? In Searching for the Best Place on Earth, Justin McElroy brings his endlessly curious eye to that question. The result is a smart, warm and often very funny travelogue—and one of the funnest books about cities I’ve read in ages.” — Charles Montgomery, author of Happy City

“Truly a joy to read, Searching for the Best Place on Earth is as much an in-depth, world travel guide as it is a look into the curious life and mind of one of British Columbia’s finest reporters.” — Bob Kronbauer, host of Now You Know BC, CHEK TV

LET IT BE DONE: The Fiat Echoes Still is an original musical that connects Mary’s courageous “Yes” to God with the struggles of today’s generation.

Set between biblical Nazareth and the modern world, the story follows Mary as she embraces God’s calling, while Anna faces her own struggles with doubt, identity, expectations, and finding her place in the world—mirroring the challenges many young people experience today.

Through all-original songs, drama, and powerful transitions between past and present, the musical reminds us that questions of faith, purpose, belonging, and hope transcend time.

At its heart, Let It Be Done is a story of courage, faith, and the power of saying “Yes” even when the path ahead is uncertain.

Shaun Majumder is a beloved Canadian comedian who has been active on the scene for more than two decades. He currently stars as “Father Khatri” in MGM+‘s acclaimed series FROM and recently appeared as “Gary” in Peacock’s THE MINIATURE WIFE, opposite Elizabeth Banks and Matthew Macfadyen. His recent work also includes portraying “Dr. Voor” in STAR TREK: STRANGE NEW WORLDS. Equally adept in comedy and drama, Shaun’s screen credits include 24, THE FIRM, DETROIT 1-8-7, UNHITCHED, and CEDRIC THE ENTERTAINER PRESENTS.

Shaun first became a household name through his legendary seventeen-season run on CBC’s “This Hour Has 22 Minutes”, where his singular voice as a performer and writer earned multiple Gemini and Canadian Screen Awards, establishing him as one of Canada’s most distinctive comedic talents.

Today, Shaun’s creative focus is increasingly centered on authorship and original storytelling through his production company, LAFBOY. Conceived as a home for bold, emotionally resonant stories, LAFBOY is dedicated to creating work that moves people. Projects that balance humour and heart while exploring identity, family, belonging, and the complexities of human connection.

As a writer, producer, and director, Shaun is developing a slate of premium film and television projects that reflect his unique perspective and genre-fluid sensibility, ranging from elevated comedy and prestige drama to socially conscious storytelling rooted in character and place.

With a career that continues to evolve beyond performance alone, Shaun Majumder is emerging as a singular creative voice, committed to building meaningful, globally relevant stories that entertain, challenge, and endure.

CHRISTOPHER TITUS is a prolific stand-up comedian, writer, actor, and producer. As a creator, he has sold shows to NBC, ABC, FOX and Comedy Central. His wildly innovative multi-cam half hour “Titus” premiered to critical and audience acclaim on Fox, earning the show an Emmy nomination, while Titus himself received a WGA Award nomination for his writing. Following “Titus”, Christopher starred in ABC’s “Big Shots”, acting opposite Dylan McDermott, Michael Vartan and Josh Malina.

He also starred in the NBC one-hour pilot, “Future Tense” and created and starred in the Bryan Cranston-directed pilot, “Special Unit” for Comedy Central. And he recently wrote, directed, and starred in a feature version of “Special Unit” which won the L.A. Film Award for Best Comedy Feature and the Hope Film Awards jury prize for Best Director.

Christopher has written and starred in ten 90-minute comedy specials, with several spending months on the Billboard Top 10 comedy chart. He recently released his tenth special, “Carrying Monsters”, a bookend companion piece to Norman Rockwell is Bleeding (his very first show and the source material for the Fox series). His podcast, “The Armageddon Update/Titus Podcast” has over 10 million downloads. During the worst days of the pandemic, he used his self-owned studio as a safe space to exec produce and direct specials for Ron Funches, Fortune Feimster and Everlast.

You know him as a finalist (and fan favourite!) from Kevin Hart’s Netflix series Funny AF, but Usama Siddiquee has also made standout appearances in Inventing Anna, Survival of the Thickest, And Just Like That, Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens, and more!

Known for his rapid-fire delivery and wildly relatable storytelling, Usama’s comedy covers everything from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating disasters and family chaos. Thursday, September 3 – RESCHEDULED TO 2027
Due to an unforeseen scheduling conflict, Usama Siddiquee’s Thursday, September 3, 2026 7pm show at Rio Theatre in Vancouver, BC has been rescheduled to Tuesday, February 23, 2027 during Just For Laughs VANCOUVER 2027.

Your September 3 tickets have been transferred to Usama’s February 23 show at 7:00pm, and will be reissued within 48 hours via Outbox.

If you are unable to make this rescheduled date and require a refund, please send an email request for refund within 30 days toboxoffice@jflvancouver.com (emails must be received by Thursday, September 24, 2026 at 5pm Pacific).

We apologize for the disappointment this may have caused.

Thank you for your understanding and supporting live comedy!

Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City, who can most recently be seen as a finalist (and fan favorite!) on Kevin Hart’s new series for Netflix, Funny AF.

As an actor, Usama can be seen scene-stealing in Netflix’s Inventing Anna and Survival of the Thickest, HBO’s And Just Like That, Comedy Central’s Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens, and FX’s Better Things. He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy Best of the Best, alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

In 2024, Usama made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off America’s Got Talent. Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018.

Rafaella Rabinovich is an internationally trained, award-winning costume designer working across film, television, and live performance. Her credits span major studios and networks including Netflix, The CW, ABC, TBS, Disney, Lifetime, Discovery Channel, and Sony, with notable projects including To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before, Project Mc2, Kung Fu, Stranger in Town, and the upcoming thriller Harmonia staring Carrie Coon, Lily James, Bella Ramsey, and Odessa Young. Her work has earned multiple CAFTCAD Awards, Leo honors, a Costume Society of America Design Award, a Day Time Creative Emmy nomination as well as a Children’s & Family Emmy Award win and recognition at the 27th and 28th Costume Designers Guild Awards for Dandyland. @costume_designer101

A SHOW FOR ALL GENDERS… 19+ ONLY WARNING!

No extreme nudity, just extreme hilarity.

A regular on the Sydney comedy circuit, Jenny Tian exploded onto our #fyp during the pandemic notching up millions of likes and amassing a collective online audience of 1M+. Her debut solo show Picture This sold out to audiences up and down the east coast of Australia and was released as a YouTube special where it has nearly a million views. Her second hour Chinese Australian: A Tale of Internet Fame sold out across Australia and took her to her first ever runs at the Edinburgh Fringe and West End’s Boulevard Theatre, also selling out both. Off the back of her stand up success, Jenny has secured spots on the lineup for the 2024, 2025, and 2026 Melbourne International Comedy Festival Galas and as a cast member in season 2 of Taskmaster AU, the latter earning her a Logie nomination for Best New Talent.

After a stint in London, Jenny is now living in New York and just completed her first US tour of her most recent hour, the aptly titled Jenny’s Travels, and has been named by Deadline as a stand-up to keep an eye on in 2026. Recently announced as a recipient of Screen Aus and YouTube’s funding initiative, Skip Ahead, Jenny is in post-production on Dupermarket, a web series that she’s starring in and co-writing with Patrick Golamco. Her third special, Supreme Mother, launched on Veeps in May 2026.

The iconic “Half Italian, Half Jersey Boy” brings his viral dating stories and emotional reflections to live audiences this fall.

Outback Presents is proud to announce that viral storyteller, author, and live performer Davide de Pierro will bring his unique live storytelling experience to Canada this fall with three special performances, including the Rio Theatre on Sunday, November 1 – Monday, November 2.

Known for his candid reflections on relationships and the everyday moments that define the human experience, De Pierro has built a devoted online following of more than 6 million across TikTok and Instagram, where his commentary on dating, personal growth, and modern life regularly reaches millions of viewers.

Inspired by his newly released novel The Letters I Never Sent, the live show blends personal storytelling, humor, and audience conversation. Throughout the night, De Pierro will deliver a monologue and read selections from the book, followed by an open Q&A with the audience. Limited meet-and-greet opportunities will also be available for those who purchase in advance.

“The show is a night out together,” said De Pierro. “It’s storytelling, conversation, some laughs, and hopefully a reminder that we’re all navigating a lot of the same things — relationships, personal growth, and the moments in life that connect us. If people leave feeling a little lighter and a little less alone, then it was a good night.”

The Saturday Morning All-You-Can-Eat Cereal Cartoon Party is returning to the Rio Theatre … TWICE! Now you have two chances to experience the fun times, on Saturday, October 24 AND Saturday, October 31 Get ready for a specially-curated all-new lineup of retro TV goodness covered in sugary cereal. It’s Volume XV – Halloween Style!

Kids today may not realize the significance of the Saturday morning ritual, but once upon a time, we had to wait a whole week to get our cartoon fix, and when we got it, we tended to binge. Well – welcome to The Saturday Morning All-You-Can-Eat Cereal Cartoon Party – that special time when kids and kids-at-heart get to relive the exciting Saturday morning ritual of non-stop retro cartoons, and binge on the multi-colored sugary cereals that used to be a part of every “balanced” breakfast!

The cartoon lineup is always a mystery, but Volume X will be covered in an extra spooktacular Halloween coating – so expect to see even more monsters, sci-fi, sleuths, superheroes and all kinds of 2D silliness. Expect the unexpected, from faves and obscurities spanning the ’30s through the ’90s, all punctuated with vintage commercials, PSAs and station IDs for a 3-hour trip down memory lane! Get ready for a sugar rush and an explosion of nostalgia in one hair-raising morning.

Even better…? COSTUME CONTEST! Show us what you’ve got, or maybe just give your costume a test-drive before the big day. Costumes (and, as always, comfy pajamas) are welcome and encouraged.

Curated by David Bertrand
